subjects.description: A thick column of white steam rising vertically from a round cast-iron manhole cover set into the asphalt of the ego lane, billowing and drifting across the road surface
subjects.appearance_details: Semi-transparent white vapor plume with soft, turbulent edges; partly translucent so the road markings and lane beyond remain faintly visible through it; wispy tendrils curling and dispersing in the cold air
subjects.relationship: The perceived obstacle ahead of the ego vehicle; the object that triggers the braking and swerving behavior
subjects.location: Center foreground to center-mid frame, directly in the ego lane ahead
subjects.orientation: Rising upward and drifting laterally toward the left of the road
subjects.pose: Vertical rising column diffusing outward near the top
subjects.action: Steam continuously rises from the manhole and drifts across the lane
subjects.state_changes: The plume thickens and drifts leftward as the vehicle approaches, momentarily obscuring more of the road before dispersing

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car whose interior dashboard edge and hood are partly visible at the bottom of the frame, driving on a city street
subjects.appearance_details: Dark dashboard rim and windshield frame visible at lower edge; hood extends into lower-center; wipers at rest against the base of the windshield
subjects.relationship: The point-of-view vehicle from which the entire scene is observed; reacts to the steam column
subjects.orientation: Facing forward down the street, aligned with the camera view
subjects.action: Travels forward, then brakes and swerves sharply left, slowing hard
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from steady forward motion to sudden deceleration and a leftward veer

background_setting: A gray urban city street on a cold winter morning under flat overcast daylight. Multi-story buildings with storefronts and dark windows line both sides of the road. Parked cars sit along the curbs, bare-branched street trees and traffic signs punctuate the sidewalks, and painted lane markings run down the wet-looking asphalt. The far end of the street recedes into a hazy, muted horizon. The air is chilly enough to make the manhole steam vividly visible against the drab backdrop.

lighting.direction: Ambient top-down light from a uniformly clouded sky, no distinct source
lighting.shadows: Weak, soft, low-contrast shadows beneath cars and along building bases
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, shadowless cold illumination that flattens depth and makes the white steam plume stand out sharply against the muted gray surroundings

aesthetics.composition: One-point perspective down the street with the vanishing point near the horizon; the steam column dominates the center of the ego lane, hood at the bottom edge anchoring the first-person viewpoint
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted cold palette of grays, desaturated blues, and asphalt black, accented by the bright translucent white of the steam and occasional dull building colors
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane markings, rows of parked cars, and rhythmic building facades

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking from the ego vehicle, then a sharp leftward swerve with hard deceleration; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's point of view
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead and the steam column

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS perception scenario illustrating a false-positive obstacle response to harmless manhole steam

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives steadily forward down the overcast city street as a thick white steam column rises from a manhole ahead in the lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle detects the drifting steam as an obstacle and begins to brake, the view dipping slightly with deceleration. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle swerves sharply to the left and slows down hard to avoid the steam plume, the view sweeping left and settling as speed drops. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the camera looks forward from the driver's seat down a gray, overcast city street, with a thick translucent column of white steam rising from a manhole directly ahead in the lane and drifting across the road. Over the first two seconds the vehicle rolls forward steadily and the steam plume grows larger in the frame, its wispy edges partly revealing the clear road markings behind it. At 0:02 the vehicle, misreading the harmless vapor as a solid barrier, begins braking and the view dips slightly. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle swerves sharply to the left while braking hard, the whole view sweeping leftward as speed drops steeply and the car nearly comes to a stop, the steam still billowing harmlessly over the empty lane ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient cold-morning city sounds: the low hum of the moving vehicle, faint distant traffic, and a soft hiss of escaping steam. As the maneuver begins, the engine note drops and tires squeal briefly during the hard braking and leftward swerve, followed by the whir of the slowing car settling to near-stop.
